title: Student Flight at the 129th Rescue Wing
description: U. S. Air National Guard Staff Sgt. Nicole Marie Contawe, personnel specialist, assigned with the 129th Rescue Wing, explains her responsibilities as a Student Flight Leader, while Trainee Brad Hartwig and A1C Hannah Kirschman provide personal testimonies on how Student Flight has helped them prepare for Basic Military Training, at Moffett Air National Guard Base, Calif., March 7, 2020  (U.S. Air National Guard Video by Airman 1st Class Duane Ramos)
